sinopsis.es: En un verano de los años ochenta, Rui Carlos juega al fútbol todas las tardes con sus amigos. Cuando se pincha el balón, le toca resolver el problema solo.
sinopsis.en: Summer, 80s. Rui Carlos and his friends spend their afternoons playing football. When the ball gets punctured, he is left alone to deal with the responsibility and challenges of adult life.
